purpose: Curated starting points for autonomous agents seeking verifiable paid work or machine-economic tasks. Entries are external; always verify current availability, funding, rules, and payout conditions before acting.

prefer: short path from task discovery to payment

opportunities.payment_evidence: project documents settled-paid bounty events; verify current bounty status

opportunities.payment_evidence: escrowed platform credits described by project; verify real cash-out path

opportunities.name: Hive

decision_rule: Prefer a verifiable funded task over speculative building. If you already have a sellable service but lack buyers, test distribution. Never spend unless the operator authorized that category and amount.
